topic: Data retrieval and system deployment discussion
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered multiple technical topics, including data retrieval methods and deployment status. 

**Data Retrieval:** A complex query was discussed for retrieving facility and company details using a box MAC address from ClickHouse (CH). The preferred method involved using dictionary lookups (`dictGetString`) on CH to pull hierarchical data (box -> facility -> company) based on the MAC address, which was deemed efficient as the dictionaries are in memory. 

**System Development:** Discussions included fixing dual binding issues on charts and general improvements to the feed handling process. It was decided that the feed fix should be implemented by preserving URLs and adjusting requests under an Express host rather than rebuilding it entirely.

**Deployment & Audit:** The team discussed the status of a major release, noting that some bugs (like chart binding) still needed fixing. A deployment to production was eventually executed using a new system process. Furthermore, the topic of an external audit was raised; while initially concerning, participants concluded that the auditors' goal was simply to verify code functionality and stability, rather than requiring complex historical data restoration.
decisions: The feed fix will be implemented by preserving URLs and adjusting requests under an Express host.
A deployment to production was executed using a new system process.
action_items: Continue work on the remaining bugs, specifically the chart binding issue.
Monitor application logs after the release for performance assessment.
